input.free_text_description: This system is a content management platform that serves Content Creator, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for course, course, course student. Secondary concerns include social functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Content Creator, I want to interact with student course functionality, so that I can accomplish my student course-related tasks.
As a Content Creator, I want to interact with writer book functionality, so that I can accomplish my writer book-related tasks.
As a Content Creator, I want to interact with reviewer article functionality, so that I can accomplish my reviewer article-related tasks.
As a Content Creator, I want to interact with player weapon functionality, so that I can accomplish my player weapon-related tasks.
As a Content Creator, I want to interact with restaurant dish functionality, so that I can accomplish my restaurant dish-related tasks.
